# The case resolves mkfs.ext2 to its own stub (see stubbin/) instead of the
# host's e2fsprogs. PATH is the harness's standard value with the case-relative
# stub directory in front: a relative entry resolves inside the case's scratch
# directory, which is the same directory both engines run from, so the
# recording does not depend on the developer's PATH or on any installed mkfs.
PATH=./stubbin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
